subject: general
question: Who shared the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2005 with Barry J Marshall for the discovery of the Helicobacter pylori bacterium and its role in gastritis and peptic ulcer disease?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Robin Warren__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Robin Warren: **The Nobel Prize in Physiology or** Medicine 2005 was awarded jointly to Barry J. Marshall** and** ****J. Robin Warren**** "for their discovery of the bacterium Helicobacter pylori and its role in gastritis and peptic ulcer disease."**
 
• **John Robin** Warren AC is **an Australian pathologist.**
 
• Previously it was believed **stomach ulcers were caused by stress.**
 
• The most usual causes of** peptic ulcers** are infection with the bacterium **Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) **and the durable use of nonsteroidal** anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs)** such as** ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin IB, others) and naproxen sodium (Aleve)**. 
 
• Stress and spicy foods do not cause peptic ulcers.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd22803828dbc34780e5b06a1bff479895d91a43a3f89fe1984ccc32b6b8875b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​****Paul Christian Lauterbur** was **an American chemist** who got the Nobel Prize in **Physiology or Medicine in 2003.**** **
 
• Codirector **Richard Axel** won a** Nobel Prize in 2004** for his groundbreaking work in **decoding olfaction, our sense of smell**. 
 
• **Oliver Smithies was a British-American geneticist and physical biochemist**. 
 
• He is known for introducing starch as a medium for** gel electrophoresis in 1955.**
